headline: NetEase (NTES) Q3 Earnings Top Estimates, Revenues Rise Y/Y
summary:
NetEase, Inc. NTES reported third-quarter 2020 non-GAAP earnings per American Depositary Share (ADS) of 64 cents per share that beat the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 146.2% but declined 31.9% year over year.

Also, revenues of $2.74 billion beat the consensus mark by 3.9%.

In local currency, revenues of RMB18.6 billion increased 27.5% from the year-ago quarter, driven by steady performance of online game services and Youdao business.

headline: Texas Instruments posts rare revenue rise as consumers splurge on electronics
summary: Texas Instruments Inc reported its first quarterly revenue growth in nearly two years on Tuesday, a rebound the chipmaker credited to people stuck at home splurging on electronic gadgets for remote work and entertainment during the COVID-19 pandemic.

headline: Texas Instruments beats quarterly revenue estimates
summary: Texas Instruments Inc beat third-quarter revenue estimates on Tuesday, as a global shift to work from home boosted demand for its chips used in servers and electronic products.
